General information about New Zealand online casinos

### Safe & Secure

Offshore casinos in New Zealand that accept Kiwis should hold a license from a strict regulator like the Malta Gaming Authority or the UK Gambling Commission. The [best online casinos that payout](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/best-payout-casinos/) legitimate winnings tend to be supervised by proactive regulators like these. Serious regulators won’t hesitate to fine, suspend or cancel licenses for serious rule violations.

Safe and secure casinos emphasise player safety, with websites using SSL encryption, antispam/antivirus software, two-factor authentication (2FA), etc. Likewise, the games using random number generators (RNGs) must be tested and certified as fair by licensed independent third parties.

### Customer Support

A good measure of the quality of the best online casinos NZ is their attention to detail, particularly concerning customer support. A lesser-quality operator might skimp on agents to save costs. The best New Zealand online offers multiple communication channels, including live chats, email and a dedicated telephone line.

They may also be active on social media, like “X” (formerly known as Twitter), Discord or other platforms. Regardless, a 24/7 team is preferable to opening hours.

### Language & Currency

Not surprisingly, English is the default language of online gambling NZ visitors. The better NZ online casino sites cater for English speakers from the country. If you’ve visited enough sights, you will inevitably find ones with poorly written or translated English. It’s incredible how poor-quality content takes away from the overall experience.

It goes without saying that the best online casino NZ cashiers accept New Zealand dollar deposits and withdrawals. Supporting payment methods should include a combination of instant banking, e-wallets, e-vouchers, mobile banking, etc.

## Payment Options

Banking at an online casino, including payment methods, is integral to the overall experience of a person from New Zealand. Therefore, it’s important to find a reasonable variety of payment providers, including credit cards, e-wallets, prepaid vouchers, instant banking, bitcoin, etc.

Fortunately, the latest online casino accommodates many instant, safe and secure ways of depositing to an online casino NZ dollars account. Each method uses security measures like passwords, encryption, verification codes, etc. Generally, top NZ casinos don’t apply handling fees on transactions. Still, I suggest consulting the fee schedule of your chosen provider to avoid surprises.

![online casino deposit](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2022/05/Payments-Desktop.png)

### Mastercard/Visa Cards

Visa and Mastercard are two of the largest and most popular banking methods at casino sites. This is not surprising, given the rise of debit & credit card casinos as deposit and

withdrawal options.

A Mastercard or Visa debit card links a user’s bank account to a merchant, like an online casino. These providers debit funds directly from a player’s financial institution and instantly credits them into a casino account. Conversely, a credit card from one of these providers transfers money borrowed from the issuer. For this reason, I only recommend this method to disciplined (responsible) gamblers.

Besides the convenience, these types of payments generally qualify for promotions. However, the drawback is that payments are not as discrete as other methods like e-wallets since they appear on financial statements. Furthermore, many online casinos don’t support credit card cashouts, meaning players must use another method.

### Neosurf/Paysafecard

Another popular way of crediting a player account is prepaid vouchers (e-vouchers), like Neosurf and [PaySafe NZ](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/paysafe-casino/). Like credit/debit cards, they are instant, safe, secure and qualify for promotions. These methods eliminate the necessity of providing bank card details to casinos.

Neosurf uses a 10-digit PIN, whereas Paysafecard uses a 16-digit PIN. A personal identification number ensures that the money on the voucher can’t be stolen.

Prepaid vouchers like these can be bought from online and land-based retailers in different sizes, allowing players to control the amount they spend. They are also discrete since prepaid voucher transactions don’t appear on financial statements.

The significant drawback to prepaid vouchers is that they don’t support online casino cashouts. However, in some cases, a withdrawal may be possible into a myNeosurf or Paysafecard e-wallet.

### Neteller

Neteller casinos are among the most popular of all e-wallet casinos. Neteller is part of the same group that owns Skrill and Paysafecard. It supports NZD and many other fiat currencies, like AUD.

Neteller is another easy, fast, safe and secure NZD deposit and withdrawal method. It eliminates the need to provide card details to an online casino. Like a prepaid voucher, transactions are discrete since they don’t appear on bank statements. They can also be a good way of controlling spending, as it’s impossible to transfer more than the balance on the card.

A potential downside to Neteller is that some casinos exclude Neteller deposits from qualifying for promotions. This may also be true of other e-wallet providers, like Skrill.

### PayByPhone

PayByPhone is another fast, safe, secure and straightforward way of depositing to a player account on casino sites. Like e-wallets, this payment provider doesn’t need a player to provide bank details to the casino. From the cashier section, choose this payment method, input the deposit size, enter your mobile number and confirm the transaction. It’s as simple as that!

Mobile deposits, like PayByPhone, generally qualify for deposit bonuses and other promotions. The most significant disadvantage of this payment provider is that it doesn’t support a PayByPhone casino withdrawal.

### Poli

Finally, Poli Casinos accept this instant banking option, linking a player account to an individual’s bank account. Registering for a Poli account is unnecessary if you want to use this payment provider at casino sites. Payments are instant, easy, safe, and secure, as with the previously mentioned providers.

## Best Bonus Offers at Online Casinos

![online casino bonus](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2022/05/Bonus-Desktop.png)

Undoubtedly, the best gambling sites in New Zealand are creative, offering variations of standard promos, like no deposit bonuses, free spins, match bonuses and cashback.

Although the mechanics can be very similar, the differences at casinos can boil down to the qualifying games, the number of free spins/quantity of bonus money, the playthrough wagering requirement, game weights, etc.

Bonus T&Cs often lay out the qualifying [minimum deposit](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/1-dollar-deposit-casinos/), max bet/round, the promotion’s shelf life, limits on withdrawable winnings, qualifying games, etc. The terms and conditions can also outline prohibited activities that can disqualify a player. For example, a promotion on roulette games may prohibit even money bets. Similarly, hedges on sports bets are often typically disqualified.

### Free Spins Bonus

Free spins often find their way into welcome packages alongside match bonuses at casino sites. However, casinos regularly offer them to existing players, too. This promo usually applies to a specific pokie determined by the operator. Finding free spins on classic pokies, like Book of Dead (Play’n GO) or Gonzo’s Quest (NetEnt), is not unusual. However, some studios and/or casinos sponsor free spins promotions on new releases or to promote a pokie.

### No Deposit Bonuses

An unusual type of casino bonus is the new online casino no deposit bonus because it doesn’t require any upfront money to enjoy. Here, casinos typically offer a small number of free spins or bonus money relative to deposit bonuses.

The bonus T&Cs and rollover requirements tend to be similar to other promotions. Still, no deposit bonuses almost always have two additional terms. First, the withdrawable winnings after completing the playthrough requirements are limited at a typically lower level than other promotions. Second, a player must make a minimum deposit before cashing out their winnings.

### Cashback Bonuses

Although not an unbreakable rule, casinos online NZ tend to offer cashback bonuses to existing players instead of new ones. They may be part of a loyalty rewards program or a general and ongoing promotion.

These casino bonuses work differently than free spins or match bonuses since they trigger after a player has lost substantially all of their deposit. These effectively allow players to win back some of their losses at casinos, using bonus money calculated as a percentage of losses. Some casinos award cashback as real money. However, this is not as common.

## Standard Terms & Conditions at Online Casinos

![gambling mode](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-video-player.png)It’s easy to encounter unfamiliar gambling industry terminology when playing at a casino, confusing some New Zealand members. This is especially true concerning the best new casino bonuses and cashier section. Therefore, I compiled a few bullet points with information explaining some of the more recurring terms you’ll find at casinos.

- **Bonus money/credit:** Casino play money awarded by a bonus that can’t be withdrawn. It’s credited to a separate account since it’s not actual cash. However, completing the rollover (playthrough) requirement transforms the remaining balance into withdrawable winnings, subject to limits.
- **Cashout/withdrawal limit**: The maximum amount of money that can be withdrawn in a day, week, or month.
- **Casino withdrawal time:** The time a casino takes to process and approve a cashout request. This can take up to a few days to complete. The casino will check that no T&Cs were broken to arrive at your winnings. Furthermore, it may need to conduct a verification process before approving your request.
- **Game contributions (game weights):** A dollar wagered with bonus money does not necessarily equal a dollar towards completing the playthrough requirement. The game contribution of pokies is usually 100%. However, other categories, like table games, can be much lower.
- **KYC check (verification):** The compliance process where a casino verifies a player’s age, residence and identity using government-issued documents and statements.
- **Match Bonus:** This is when a casino matches a cash deposit by a percentage in bonus money. It’s almost always found in welcome packages. It often goes by the name of a reload bonus when offered to existing players.
- **Minimum deposit requirement:** The minimum threshold for a qualifying deposit.
- **Playthrough (wagering) requirement:** The number of times bonus money must be wagered before becoming cash. It’s often expressed as a multiple, like 40x, or as a dollar value. For example, a NZ$100 bonus with a 40x playthrough requirement must be wagered the equivalent of NZ$4,000 before becoming cash.
- **Return to player (RTP)**: The theoretical payback (expressed as a percentage) of every dollar wagered, calculated over millions of simulated rounds. For example, a 97% RTP implies a player, in theory, wins back 97 cents of every $1 bet.
- **Signup (registration) Bonus**: A bonus offered to a new signup before making their first deposit.
- **Volatility (Variance)**: A game classification into low, medium or high risk/return. It refers to the expected magnitude and frequency of wins. A low-volatility game tends to have frequent wins around the same size as the bet. On the other hand, a high-volatility casino game tends to have higher payouts that are far less frequent.

The New Zealand Gambling Act (2003) allows New Zealand players to gamble at international NZ casino sites. However, the legislation prohibits online gambling sites on servers in the country.

## **Pros and Cons of Gambling at a Casino Apple Pay in New Zealand**

These days, New Zealanders can enjoy a versatile selection of casino games on their Apple device and safely process payments with this contactless pay-by-phone method. This comes with its set of pros and cons, which we’ll discuss now.

### **Pros of Apple Pay Casino NZ Sites**

Here are the pros of using Apple Pay at online casinos in New Zealand:

- Available for anyone who owns an iOS -powered device. Apple Pay works on iPhone 6 or over, iPads, and Apple watches
- Simple to use. All you need to do to use it is connect your bank card to your Apple Wallet, and you can do instant transactions
- This is especially safe since you won’t be entering any banking details directly on the casino site
- Zero fees. If you gamble at approved casinos, you’ll pay no extra fees for making payments with this method

Instant transactions with Touch ID. You can complete transactions fast by using the Touch ID feature without entering codes or drawing patterns

### **Cons of Apple Pay Casinos**

Here are the cons:

- Lack of casinos that offer it. The biggest con is that most casinos in NZ and worldwide don’t have this method on their list just yet. But, things are changing at a rapid pace
- Not available for withdrawals. This method can only be used as a deposit. You’d have to use another method for withdrawal later on

Not available for Android and other users. Android users still come at the biggest numbers in NZ and worldwide, and this method is only available to Apple users

## **Bonuses Found at Best Apple Pay Casinos**

Most NZ online casinos will offer you at least a welcome bonus. Bonuses come in different sizes, with different terms, etc. Some of the most frequent bonuses you can find at Apple Pay casinos – and the most popular are the following:

- _No deposit bonus._ A no deposit bonus will give you something for free without requiring a deposit. This is usually a welcome bonus given on registration, and it’s most likely to come with wagering terms.
- _Welcome bonus._ A welcome bonus is available in almost every casino. This is a one-time offer that you get when you sign up and make your first deposit. It can be a single bonus or a package.
- _Match bonus._ Most welcome bonuses are match bonuses, which means that the casino will match your deposit by a given percentage.
- _Cashback bonus._ If you are given a [casino cashback bonus](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/cashback-casino-bonus/), this means that the casino will return a portion of your losses back. This is the rarest option in NZ casinos, and it’s usually given to VIP players.

Free spins bonuses. Most of the bonuses will be – or at least include free spins. This applies to welcome bonuses, no deposit bonuses, regular promotions, VIP offers, etc. It means that you get to spin the reel on a pokie for free.

## FAQ

Is Apple Pay safe to use in NZ online casinos?

As long as you play at a safe casino, the banking methods you offer are safe. Apple Pay also has its security measures and is considered a highly safe method for payments.

Can I claim any bonuses when I use Apple Pay?

Unless otherwise indicated in the bonus T&C, you can use the given banking methods to deposit and claim all kinds of bonuses at online casinos.

Are there any fees associated with Apple Pay transactions in New Zealand?

No, Apple Pay transactions at online casinos are typically free of additional charges. Still, you should check the casino’s terms carefully before choosing a banking method.

Do all online casinos in NZ accept Apple Pay?

While Apple Pay is gaining popularity, only a limited number of online casinos accept it. However, our recommended casinos are among those that do accept Apple Pay for convenient transactions.

Can I use Apple Pay on all Apple devices?

Apple Pay is available on most Apple devices, including iPhones, iPads, and Macs, ensuring compatibility and ease of use for New Zealand players. You need at least an iPhone 6 to use it, though.

## **How We Review Online Casinos Google Pay**

Our team of review experts will carefully review NZ casinos before we can give you any recommendations. Here is what we look for in terms of Google Pay.

### **Security of Paying at a Casino with Google Pay**

The casinos we recommend to New Zealanders are some of the safest you can find online. We’ll make sure that not only the casinos offer secure options like Google Pay, but that they also have security measures in place such as SSL encryption for your data.

### **Extra Fees for Making Payments at Casinos Google Pay**

You shouldn’t have to pay any fees to make payments with Google Pay. We’ll examine each casino and make sure that deposits are free of fees.

### **Speed of Deposits and Withdrawals at Online Casinos Google Pay**

Quick withdrawals are very popular with online gamblers. While you can’t use Google Pay to make a withdrawal, we’ll check if the casino processes withdrawal requests fast and if it offers same-day methods as an alternative.

## **Overview of the Google Pay Casino Transactions**

G Pay is a trending method for transactions at casinos. The deposits are instant and free of fees, but there are some details about the transactions you should know about. Let’s take a look at them.

- Google Pay has a weekly deposit limit of $10,000
- There are no processing fees included
- The game selection is wide for Kiwis using this method. Google Pay works with leading companies like NetEnt, Microgaming and Betsoft

### **Pros and Cons of Playing at an Online Casino Google Pay**

Let’s take a look at the pros and cons of using this payment method.

#### **Pros**

- Can be funded with all cards. You can use Visa and MasterCard to fund your Google Pay account. You only need to enter the details once and save it for future transactions.
- Google Pay is currently one of the safest methods offered at NZ casinos. It’s powered and protected by Google and encrypts all data when doing transactions.
- No need to enter banking details. To deposit with G Pay, you don’t have to enter any card information or other banking detail at the casino.
- Available for both iOS and Android users. Apple Pay is limited to iOS users only, but G Pay is available to all. This is why it’s more widely accepted and a preferred option by many.
- Simple payments. One of the best things about this method is its simplicity. You needn’t carry your cards or jump through hoops to deposit. You just need your phone and loaded G Pay account.
- 0% fees. Provided that you gamble at a high-ranked New Zealand casino, there should be no fees associated with this method.

#### **Cons**

- No withdrawals. The biggest downside from using Google Pay is that it’s not available for withdrawals. You’ll need to cash out using alternative methods.
- Not as available as other options. Cards, for instance, are available at almost every casino. Google Pay is not as often found as a banking option.

Is it safe for me to play at Google Pay casinos?

Google Pay is safe as a banking option, but you still have to make sure to gamble on a licensed, reputable website to ensure your safety.

What’s the minimum deposit at Google Pay casinos?

Most casinos will set their own limit for minimum deposits. This can start at $10 and go upward. There are casinos for every budget, so make sure to check this before you sign up.

Are there any fees when I use Google Pay at online casinos in NZ?

No. There shouldn’t be any fees for your deposits at casinos. Some casinos may impose fees, so make sure to check this before you play.

Can I use Google Pay to make withdrawals in New Zealand?

No. G Pay NZ casinos only offer this option for deposits. Due to the nature of the method, you cannot use it to make withdrawals.

## The Pros and Cons of Using Maestro in Online Casinos

There are obvious advantages to using this banking option in online gambling:

- It’s easily available. You don’t need to create an e-wallet account and connect your main payment method to it. You can simply use the card from a New Zealand bank that you already have.
- Maestro has an additional level of security on its own. In case your info is compromised, you can contact your bank, and they will effectively solve the issue.
- It’s really easy to use Maestro in online casinos. You just add the details that you usually use with other online transactions.

But let’s talk about the other side of the coin: the disadvantages:

- Providing debit card information online is not as quick as using an e-wallet.
- The processing time for a withdrawal is longer, too.
- Some casinos don’t allow you to withdraw money on a NZ debit card.

## History of MasterCard Payment Method in Online Gambling

![mastercard casino](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-news.png)MasterCard has a long history. Originally, it was created in 1969 as Interbank when several regional bankcard associations formed an alliance. It was intended as competition to BankAmericard (which today is known as Visa). In 1979, the name MasterCard was adopted and it became a staple in people’s wallets. This brand is used for credit, debit, and prepaid cards.

> [NZ casino Lucky Nugget](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/lucky-nugget-nz/) is one of the best iGaming sites that accept credit card deposits.

MasterCard and online gambling are a natural pair. When the first NewZealand casinos showed up, debit and credit cards was the most widely accepted option for a deposit and [fast withdrawal](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/fastest-payout-online-casino-nz/). Later on, e-wallets became another acceptable method for online transactions. Still, those who like to play without creating any accounts can easily use their cards at gambling sites that accept MasterCard.

## MasterCard Casino Features and Services in New Zealand

Let’s talk about the most important features of this depositing and withdrawal method. MasterCard is used for all kinds of transactions, both online and offline. It’s a plastic card with a 16-digit number that’s unique. When you enter it at New Zealand casinos that accept it as a deposit/withdrawal method, this number gives important financial information. In addition, any site will ask for this card’s security code and validity period. These three details prove that you have this card in your possession. If it’s lost or stolen, holders immediately report to their banks, so no one can use the card instead of them.

For casino MasterCard accepted, players go through a second layer of security. When they want to play with real money or trigger a casino withdrawal MasterCard, the website will ask them to prove their identity. This is done by a copy of an ID and additional documentation, depending on the casinos.

The transactions occur in the same way, regardless whether the players use credit or debit cards for transferring money.

- It’s immensely popular – as stated before, many people already use this platform, and the platform had over $15 billion in revenue in 2018 to back that statement up, so it makes sense to tap into an existing pool of potential players.
- It’s easy to set up – even if a person doesn’t have it, it’s easier to set up an account and play casino online with PayPal than with most other payment options.
- The transactions are secure and smooth – having a stress-free and effortless transaction is something that both the patrons and the casinos themselves will appreciate.
- The fees are fairly low – another incentive for people to gravitate towards this payment service is that the fees are reasonable and won’t affect the total balance much at all.
- It’s easy to transfer money to any other bank account – some casinos don’t offer many banking options, but a player can always make withdrawals to PP and then transfer their winnings to any bank of their choosing.

The bottom line is when you have such a secure and easy to use service at your disposal, why wouldn’t you use it?

## What is UKash casino deposit?

![](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-money-bag-1.png)UKash is an electronic payment method, widely used across the globe, especially for online casino deposits. What makes UKash unique is that, in order to use it, you don’t need any type of registration. UKash works with a sort of payment card, that is prepaid and can be used by anyone, at any time. To put it simply, all you need to do is find a store that sells UKash prepaid cards, purchase one, and use the code to get access to your money. Think of it as a form of voucher or gift card.

The company was founded in 2006, in the UK, and was introduced as a financial service, which allows Internet users to make online payments, load e-wallets and transfer money. One of the main reasons why the company became so popular, is because of the large number of casino sites that take UKash. The payment method became a favourite in countries such as the UK, New Zealand and the United States, which made the company reach more than 420,000 sales-points all over the world.

In 2015, UKash was purchased by [Paysafecard](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/paysafe-casino/), another company that had a similar business model. People who still have UKash vouchers can safely continue to use them, by following some simple instructions found on the Paysafecard website.

## UPayCard Casino Payments

Making an UPayCard casino deposit is fast and convenient. This e-wallet gives players the option to transfer big sums of cash safely and without too much waiting. It offers straightforward cash transfers with minimal transaction fees. There aren’t many UPayCard casinos at the moment, but the numbers are certainly growing.

One of the things that make this e-wallet stand out is that it opens numerous methods for payment. You can use other e-wallets, your credit cards, and even cryptocurrency to add money to your e-wallet. Then, you can use it for smooth and carefree gambling on online sites.

### UPayCard Casino Deposit

![](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-deposit.png)Once you set up an account on the website, you need to load up the account with money. There are plenty of options here. You can add money through bank transfers, e-wallets like PayPal, Skrill, Neteller, Qiwi, Payeer, and Poli. Or, you can use your Visa or MasterCard.

When you load up the card, you can deposit and withdraw at UPayCard casinos, make online purchases on other websites, and even send money to other accounts on the platform.

Making a casino deposit is straightforward. You can select the option at the UPayCard casino you found and make a deposit. Or, if you have a physical or virtual UPay card, you can use it anywhere that accepts MasterCard for a deposit.

### UPayCard Casino Withdrawal

Most reliable UPayCard casinos in New Zealand will allow you to use this method for withdrawals, too. The casinos don’t usually charge fees on e-wallet payments or withdrawals. But, this company charges a small commission for cashout and deposit transfers that can go up to 3.9%.

Unfortunately, this card currently does not support NZD. It only supports USD and AUD at this moment. Still, you can play at UPayCard casinos NZ that support this currency by using the card.

### UPayCard Casino Transfer Time

The transfer time will depend on the UPayCard casino you choose but in most cases, it takes hours, not days to get your money. Deposits are usually instant.

### UPayCard Casino Minimum Deposit

You have to check the casino where you decided to do UPayCard gambling to see their minimal deposit requirements. Generally, casinos don’t require more than 20 NZD. ### Fees

## What are Visa casinos?

![visa casino nz](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-review.png)These may sound like they’re a different type of service that you need to sign up for, but they’re not. It’s simply an online casino that takes Visa. In other words, when creating an account on one of these websites, you can link them to your Visa credit or debit card, so that when you make deposits or withdraw your earnings, the transaction will be made directly on your bank account. Over the years, many payment methods have come and gone, but as one of the oldest card payment providers in the world (they were launched in 1958), they are definitely here to stay, along with other reliable options, such as [Mastercard](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/mastercard-casino-nz/) and [PayPal casino NZ](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/paypal-casino-nz/).

## Visa payment system PROS and CONS

As one of the longest standing payment providers, Visa offers you many features that can help you when playing online. However, like most things, Visa casino payments have some drawbacks too. It’s all up to your needs and personal preferences. Let’s have a look at the pros and cons.

### PROS

- **Easy to use.** Visa is one of the most convenient payment systems, so you won’t have to worry about paperwork or long waiting times.
- **Secure.** The company is one of the most reliable payment providers in the world, collaborating not only with online casinos, but also with multinational retailers. They invest heavily in security, so not only is your data secure, but you also benefit from a great consumer protection program.
- **Versatile.** You can use a casino Visa card that matches your needs. From your day-to-day debit card to gift cards, credit cards, and prepaid cards, just choose the option that’s safest and most convenient for you. Although, we don’t recommend using a credit card for gambling purposes, because it’s easy to lose track of your finances.

### CONS

- **Added fees.** Many users have complained that the annual fees for Visa cards aren’t very competitive.
- **Not the best conversion rate.** If you use a prepaid card, Visa will charge you a certain percent of your transaction total for international currency conversions.

## Visa Casinos FAQ

What are the minimum and maximum deposit limits?

Every casino has its own policies for minimum and maximum deposit limits. In general, the minimum deposit limit is smaller for new players. This can be as small as $20, but the maximum limit can reach really high five-figure sums, so if you’re an experienced player, you don’t have to worry.

Can I use casino bonus codes if I’ll make a deposit with Visa?

Yes, you can. If your casino offers you a tempting bonus code, or you find it elsewhere, you can apply that code and it will work as long as it’s valid and respects the casino’s terms and conditions.

Are there any fees and taxes for Visa casino payments?

Visa does not ask special fees and taxes specifically for casino payments. That being said, the usual fees and taxes apply. So, for example if you have USD in your casino account and you withdraw them to your account, which is New Zealand dollars, currency conversion fees will apply.

Is there a mobile app for Visa casino payments?

Visa does not currently offer an app for casino payments, but you can instead download their Visa Explore app, which lets you find the latest Visa offers and promotions in your area. Otherwise, you can use your casino app and make the payment there as usual. If your local bank has a banking app, you can also use that to check your fees and transactions.

What about Visa transactions payment speed – are they instant?

Visa is one of the fastest services for best online gambling transactions. To make the most out of their efficiency, choose an online casino that accepts Visa and offers you the fastest withdrawal times.

Visa customer support – is it affable for NZ gamblers?

Yes, it is. As one of the most reputable payment providers, Visa has prompt customer service in New Zealand, so if at any time you encounter any problem, they will solve it as soon as possible.

Is it safe to use Visa for casino payments?

Visa is one of the safest options you have for casino payments. With their Visa Verification & Consumer Protection program, they’ve made it impossible for someone else other than the Visa card owner to make payments.

## Real Money Pokies Rules & Terms

Pokies are one of the simplest casino games. They involve plain rules: placing a bet, pressing the button “Spin,” and waiting until your luck comes. It seems pretty easy, yet there are a few features and specific terms every player should know about NZ pokies online. These features you can find below, which we listed and shortly explained.

- **Scatter.** It is the symbol providing you with extra spins when landing in three scatters or rounds.
- **Wilds**. This feature comes as a helping hand by replacing any other symbol on the reel. It lets more payline connections.
- **Multiplier**. This slot feature boosts wins. Every time this feature pops up, your win increases.
- **Re-spin**. This is a bonus feature that resets a spin counter. Such an approach allows you to reach long spinning sections, which also increases your chances of winning.
- **Reels**. These are the main part of a slot game where featured symbols land and brings a certain value. There are different pokies according to the number of reels: 3 and 5 reels.
- **Payline**. This feature uncovers the number of winning lines landing on the reels. Payline can include horizontal, diagonal lines, and other directions, depending on the pokie’s style.
- **Paytable**. It is a helpful spot where all symbols and layouts of possible paylines of a game are.
- **Cascading wins**. This represents a unique payout model. The special features appear in a cascading manner bringing massive payouts.

When playing real online pokies NZ, it is essential to operate with an established amount of bets – a minimum and maximum. This rule is different in different slots. The minimum bet can range between NZ$0.01 and NZ$100 or even more. Each pokie is unique, with its own betting rules. That’s why it always makes sense to get familiar with a pokie feature, practice on its demo version, and then play for real money.

## Real Money Pokies Rules & Terms

Pokies are one of the simplest casino games. They involve plain rules: placing a bet, pressing the button “Spin,” and waiting until your luck comes. It seems pretty easy, yet there are a few features and specific terms every player should know about NZ pokies online. These features you can find below, which we listed and shortly explained.

- **Scatter.** It is the symbol providing you with extra spins when landing in three scatters or rounds.
- **Wilds**. This feature comes as a helping hand by replacing any other symbol on the reel. It lets more payline connections.
- **Multiplier**. This slot feature boosts wins. Every time this feature pops up, your win increases.
- **Re-spin**. This is a bonus feature that resets a spin counter. Such an approach allows you to reach long spinning sections, which also increases your chances of winning.
- **Reels**. These are the main part of a slot game where featured symbols land and brings a certain value. There are different pokies according to the number of reels: 3 and 5 reels.
- **Payline**. This feature uncovers the number of winning lines landing on the reels. Payline can include horizontal, diagonal lines, and other directions, depending on the pokie’s style.
- **Paytable**. It is a helpful spot where all symbols and layouts of possible paylines of a game are.
- **Cascading wins**. This represents a unique payout model. The special features appear in a cascading manner bringing massive payouts.

When playing real online pokies NZ, it is essential to operate with an established amount of bets – a minimum and maximum. This rule is different in different slots. The minimum bet can range between NZ$0.01 and NZ$100 or even more. Each pokie is unique, with its own betting rules. That’s why it always makes sense to get familiar with a pokie feature, practice on its demo version, and then play for real money.

## FAQ on the Best Online Casinos NZ

Has New Zealand legalized online gambling?

The country hasn’t officially legalized online casinos. No governmental authority issues licenses for online casinos based in NZ. That being said, the Gambling Act 2003 does not regulate websites with offshore licenses and does not sanction players for using them. You can still gamble online, as long as the site has been licensed by a foreign authority.

How do I find the best casinos online?

Our reviews will help a lot. We test different websites and evaluate them by a gambler’s standards. You can check out our recommendations and warnings before creating a real-player profile.

Will the New Zealand government tax my winnings from online gambling?

No. Players are not required to pay taxes for gambling on sites with foreign licenses.

## What Are Online Fruit Machines

![fruit machines](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-jackpot-machine.png)Online fruit slot machines are a type of slot games. They have all the main characteristics as any other game of this kind but they have symbols which are represented by fruits. If you recall, we did mention that the first land slots had the same symbols. When it comes to reels, a fruit-based game can have 3 or 5 and it depends on the software developer.

Being pokies, the same rules and the same features are present. You get free spins, bonus rounds and additional games that can be implemented into the main slot. Additionally, many of these slots offer wild symbols and scatter symbols. A wild usually isn’t an ordinary icon. It is the logo of the game, 777 from traditional slots and similar.

## How I can Play Online Fruit Machines

![online fruit machine](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-cherry.png)To play this type of pokies, you need to follow a simple guide we have compiled for you. If you have already played a pokie game, then you can mimic the gameplay and you will get the desired result.

1. Load the game you wish to play
2. Set a bet or click on max bet button and activate all paylines and choose the maximum available bet
3. Spin the reels
4. Wait for the outcome

These games are extremely easy to play. Basically, you need to place a bet you are comfortable with and to press spin. The game will do everything else. Now you know how to play online fruit machines.

You can see them with [3 reels](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/online-pokies-nz/3-reel-pokies/) as the most common layout and you can enjoy their simplicity, great animations, and overall sound effects.

# Gambling Help

Gambling is a nice pastime. After a day’s work, NZ people deserve all the relaxation they can get. Life in New Zealand is laid-back compared to many countries where money means everything. But that doesn’t mean we don’t need our time away from work. There are many hobbies you can choose from. But gambling allows us New Zealanders to escape the daily reality and enjoy a couple of hours of unlimited fun.

Having said that, unlimited should never mean having no boundaries. “Too much is too much”. It sounds funny, but it holds a lot of truth. Everything with ‘too much’ in front isn’t good. Too much sugar, too much talk… You got the picture.

When gambling becomes too much, it’s now an addiction and no longer a healthy activity. It’s wise to recognize any gambling addiction signs because the negative effects of gambling can be disastrous.

So, what’s a gambling addiction? When gambling gets too much? And where to find gambling addiction help?

## Gambling addiction signs that should ring a bell

![](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-user.png)When you gamble out of compulsion, your hobby turned into an addiction. It’s really as simple as that. You can no longer control the urge to gamble if you have the money to spend or not. Let’s list some signs New Zealanders should be aware of.

### List of red flags

- **You spend more on gambling than you should.** You can’t really afford it for the moment, but you can’t stop yourself. Whatever the consequences. Seems you don’t care.
- **You use other people’s money.** When you start betting with borrowed money, you _really_ can’t control your gambling habit. Even though there is, in fact, no money, you still spend what’s not yours, probably without a clue about how to pay your creditors back. That’s a worry for later? Huge red flag. And [not a New Zealand thing to do](https://www.dia.govt.nz/gambling-statistics-expenditure) really.
- **You no longer bet because it gives you pleasure.** Instead, you gamble because you _must_.
- **You gamble like there is no tomorrow.** There isn’t any limit. Your gambling has become an excess.
- **You lie about it.** You can feel something is wrong and you try to hide your gambling gambit by lying about it. ‘No, I didn’t spend the weekend in the casino again. I went fishing,”. Yeah right. We might call this the addiction casino excuse.
- **You no longer borrow money; you just steal it.** Now you crossed the line big time. Borrowing to be able to gamble is already quite dramatic. But stealing?
- **You gamble to stop thinking.** This is probably the worst way of escaping reality. It’s like drinking to forget your worries. This is far from having fun.
- **Your family and friends worry.** Don’t ignore this. If friends and family are worried, they have a good reason. Better listen to them.

Check the most up to dated list on the site of [Ministry of Health NZ](https://www.health.govt.nz/your-health/healthy-living/addictions/harmful-gambling).

![mobile casino](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-user-.png)We can add more signs to our list. But if you recognize _only one_ of the listed signs in your behavior, that’s already alarming enough. Let’s hope not. There is nothing wrong with, for example, a trip to your favourite NZ casino, as long as you don’t show signs you suffer from “casino problems”, as to speak. Casinos and gambling addiction go way back. We prefer that you show no symptoms at all. Not even some online casino NZ addiction symptoms!

Still not sure if you have an addiction? Try taking tests on Choice Not Cance site.

![Is your gambling still just for fun?](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2019/12/gamblinghelpnz-chance.jpg)

### What to do if you think a sign applies to you?

Don’t panic. You are not crazy or anything. That’s not an NZ trademark. But It can happen to the best of us. New Zealanders are certainly not weak or irresponsible, or anything like that. Still, this can overcome people of all backgrounds, social standing and intelligence. Literally, any New Zealander can develop this harmful habit, out of the blue.

That doesn’t mean you can just shrug it off, stay calm and go on with things, the cool New Zealand way. Not this time. Overcoming your gambling addiction is very important. Help is needed. Luckily help for gambling addiction is widely available. There is even online help for gambling addiction. That’s a relief, right?

### What causes a gambling addiction and what are the dangers?

![](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-insert-coin.png)An addiction can be genetically inherited. Other causes may be depression, anxiety, or boredom. Some people, also otherwise healthy New Zealanders, are vulnerable to compulsive behavior. Or having too many problems can drive you to gamble as a form of escapism. Whatever the reason, the dangers are not to be laughed at. It can affect your mood (and cause severe mood swings), and your bank account balance. In the worst case, it can drive you to do something stupid (after having lost everything you once owned – including your loved ones).

## If so, it’s time to find help. But where in New Zealand?

Self-help for your gambling addiction is where the healing process starts. It’s time to know your limits. You might think about using one of the following:

### Therapy and Counselling for New Zealanders in trouble

1. **Addiction Counselling NZ.** “Counsellors and therapists in New Zealand who can support you when you suffer from addiction”.
2. **OnlineTherapy** offers online therapy and counselling. On the website, you will read: “Person-centered therapy helps you change by giving you the power to taking charge of your challenges, self-care and interests”.

### Medical Treatment

Gamble addiction treatment is available in New Zealand. Talk to your GP. He/she may refer you to a specialist.

### Group Support

**![](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-group.png)Supporting Families New Zealand** – Support Groups for New Zealanders.

The [PGF Services “Gambling Support and Maintenance Groups”](https://www.pgf.nz/groups) holds meetings in Auckland and any New Zealander who thinks he/she has a gambling problem can take part after being referred by a PGF Services counsellor, who you can call on 0800 664 262.

This is where New Zealanders take up responsibility and exclude themselves from gambling possibilities. You avoid NZ gambling venues or let [New Zealand casinos](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/) close your account, or whatever it takes to avoid temptation.

## Or go find Anonymous help (gambling help NZ)

### Organizations that know how to help people with a gambling addiction:

- **Supporting Families New Zealand – Addiction.** _From their website, About Us_: “SFNZ supports families, whānau and communities to foster mental wellbeing and plays a key role in the journey to wellness for people whose lives are affected by mental distress”.
- At [**PGF Services**](https://www.pgf.nz/) qualified counsellors are waiting to give free, confidential advice. Call 0800 664 262.

## FAQ

Is gambling only a problem if the person can’t afford his or her losses?

We need to realize that having a gambling problem doesn’t stop at financial problems. Nobody can afford to get into relationship trouble or losing his or her job. And what about developing mental issues or getting into legal problems? Surely scary potential consequences!

If someone gambles occasionally, he or she can’t be a problem gambler, right?

There are compulsive gamblers who gamble all the time and others who binge. Binge gamblers only gamble once in a while, but then they make up for lost time by spending huge amounts of money.

Is it a good idea to help a loved one with paying off his/her debts?

Not really. This may give your loved one the impression he can easily get away with it, and “going all-in” again (and again, and again).

## Online Roulette Game Features

The roulette rules are the simplest ones. There is a numbered grid, an online roulette wheel, chips, and a ball. The game starts with placing bets, and then the wheel and the ball are triggered by a croupier. After that, all players are nervously waiting for the ball to land. Nothing difficult in this game, but the bet you place can affect your result. So let’s find out how the round happens.

### Roulette Round

When a dealer/croupier announces the time for bets, pick any bet type you like and place the amount of money you want. Once placed, the croupier spins the wheel and waits for it to stop. When it stops, check if the number a ceramic ball landed on corresponds to your bet. If they are the same, you have won! If not, wait for the next round and chase the luck!

You can wager on a color (red/black), the odd/even, a single, multiple, high (19-36), or low (1-18) numbers, on an inside one like a street bet (covering two rows of numbers) or double street, corner (four numbers), or on the outside ones. Now, let’s go through the main types of bets used in online roulette.

### Outside bets

This type of roulette bet is the best solution for beginners and those who still don’t feel confident with the game. Outside bets involve wagering on a certain category of numbers on a numbered grid on the table. You gain better chances to win, but the payouts are less than for inside bets. You can wager differently with outside bets:

- On all odd or even numbers;
- On a group of 12 numbers;
- On all red or black numbers.

### Inside bets

This type of betting at roulette is more risky but unlocks high rewards. Here, your wager narrows, and you can place a wager on an individual number inside the roulette grid. If you are ready to risk and win big, the inside bet is what you should try. It can look like:

- Line bet includes two rows;
- Five bet includes 00, 0, 1, 2, and 3;
- A split bat involves a double straight-up bet.

## Roulette Online Variations

This section is devoted to six standard versions of the best online roulette games that you can play in any trusted casino. Don’t be surprised to see more versions on the Internet, but these described are the most played in New Zealand.

### European Roulette

This is one of the most popular versions in New Zealand, as it features the classic rules. European roulette is played with 37 numbers (36 plus zero pockets), and all the numbers are colored in black and red, while zero is green. One thing that distinguishes it from other versions is that you can bump into the progressive jackpot in some cases. But this depends on the casino you play. All chips that players use have the same color. In European roulette, the chances of winning are the highest as it has only a single zero pocket.

### American Roulette

Unlike the previous one, American roulette has the standard 36 numbers colored in red and black, plus zero and double zero pockets that are colored in green. On the table layout, you can see that the numbers on the wheel are not in the same order as in European. The extra double zero pocket greatly decreases the chances of winning. Each player uses a set of chips in different colors. This roulette version doesn’t have a progressive jackpot. Although players sometimes prefer the previous versions due to the lower house edge. It is still one of the most authentic versions you will ever play.

### French Roulette

The term comes from the French word, which means “little wheel,” So it is natural that roulette game online has its own variation in the country where it originated from. The French roulette uses the same table as the European, with the difference in the table layout. It has 36 numbers, plus a single zero, where the numbers are colored in red and black, and the zero is green. Notice also that the order of numbers is slightly different than in the previous two versions. Also, the section on outside bets is a bit displaced when compared to the previous ones.

### Premier Roulette

This is a bit modernized version of the online roulette for real money that features the same table layout as the European. The game was developed by the popular online gambling software provider Microgaming, and it became the trademark. It uses the same rules, the same table layout, and the same house edge percentage as the European version. An essential distinction is the “Chip Bomb” type of bet, which lets you place a bet on a number and numbers that are around it. In addition, the layout of the game is a bit different. There is no split screen that shows the wheel and table separately, but rather in one screen.

### Multi-Wheel Roulette

The multi-wheel roulette is another version that is highly played in online casinos. Yet it is not so common in land-based casinos. The main difference is that you are able to spin up to 8 wheels in a single bet, but you cannot place bets on separate tables. This means if you choose to bet on 8, it goes for all the wheels. It also supports inside and outside bets and uses the European rules. It is recommended to experienced players who know how to develop and use the strategies.

### Double Zero Roulette

Many online roulette NZ casinos offer this version, which highly resembles the European and French ones. However, it features the double zero slot (38 numbers in total), which is somehow placed separately from other numbers on the wheel. It has the same house edge as the American version, so we could say the house has a slight advantage over the players. Nevertheless, gamblers love to play this version as, depending on the casino, they can offer some side bonuses that are specific to certain gambling houses.

## Winning Strategies for Online Roulette NZ

The roulette strategies come in handy when you decide to enjoy real money roulette, as they can help you to obtain huge wins if used correctly. Although there are many strategies out there, we uncover the three most used ones.

### Martingale Strategy

This strategy revolves around doubling your initial bet and covering your losses in one win. For example, place $4 on a red number. If you lose, place $8 on the same number. Repeat the process until you win ultimately and erase losses. If you win, you start again with the small wager. The key is to start with small amounts of money in order to “stretch” your budget before making a profit. The main problem with this strategy is the “fallacy of probability,” meaning that if a red show 50 times in a row, no one can guarantee the next round will be black. Keep in mind that the roulette’s chances of winning are 50/50. The strategy works best for high bets.

### D’Alembert Strategy

This is a safer technique for playing roulette, as you do not need a significant bankroll to follow the strategy. It usually starts by making a small bet on a color or a range of numbers (1-18 or 19-36). If you lose, increase the bet by one. Let’s say you place a $5 bet and you lose, so you bet $6. You lose again, and you place $7. If you win, you decrease to $6 and play until you have an even number of hits and losses. The biggest problem of this strategy is knowing your wins and losses, so it is not a bad thing to use paper and pencil.

### Fibonacci Strategy

This is the most interesting strategy that you can use to play. But keep in mind that it requires a decent amount of money to start with it. With this system, you can easily cover your losses, even if you have had more losses than wins. Pick a number you want to bet on and write down a sequence of numbers, for example, 3,4,5,6,7,8, and place your first bet that is $3. If you lose, the next bet should be $7 (as you add 3 and 4). If you lose again, the next bet should be $12 (7+5), and keep it that way until you win. If you win, decrease the bet by two numbers back and continue. The biggest downside of this strategy is going too far along the sequence of numbers you wrote down, as it can cost you a lot. But you can cover your losses very quickly.

## FAQ

Can you play legally roulette in New Zealand?

Yes, it is legally allowed to participate in online gambling sessions, thanks to the Gambling Act from 2003. You can enjoy mobile roulette, desktop or web versions of this fantastic game.

What is the payout on roulette?

It is simple as you win a number of dollars for each bet you win, so it is basically 35:1, meaning you get your initial dollar bet back plus $35 in case you wan of course. You can place money on outside ones (a certain set of numbers/colors on the edge of the table) that include: red/black, odd/even, low/high, columns and dozens (the first dozen 1-12, the second 13-24, the third 25-36). All these, except the columns and dozens that pay 2:1, are paying 1:1. On the other hand, you also have inside bets, which include: straight up, split, street, corner, five-number, six-number. The first pays 35:1, the split gives 17:1, the street offers 11:1, the five-number 6:1 and the last one 5:1. When you combine all these, it turns out that the house always has 5.26% advantage over you, every time you place a single bet. We cannot tell you that the single number bet is the best, as you need to figure out which type works best for you.

How can I acquire bonuses?

Online roulette bonus can be acquired in several ways, including side game bets, promotional bonuses, and deposit bonuses. The first one is rare, as these are sometimes incorporated in unique games that are developed by a certain software team. The promotional bonuses are available for a certain period of time, and these are completely depending on the casino you are playing in. The deposit bonuses are the best ones, and you receive these upon making the deposit in a certain amount. Note that you usually must meet wagering requirements in order to cash out the profit made with these funds.

What deposit methods are available?

## The History of Baccarat NZ

Baccarat casino game dates all the way to the 15th century when the Italian gambler Felix Falguerein invented this way of entertainment. In Italian, the name of this adventure is translated to zero, and the game was initially played with tarot until it was switched to a standard deck of 52 cards. It originated as the noble game since only knights, nobles and rich people could afford to play this adventure, and the game was played in illegal pubs.

## **Baccarat Online Features**

![online baccarat nz](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2019/04/baccarat-online.png)

Baccarat online is simple to play and is much similar to blackjack. You bet before the game starts and then enjoy the gameplay at large. But the game is unique in features to complete a bet. So, let’s dig into the baccarat rules and other features.

The main rules are making a bet, placing cards face up, and deciding your actions. The goal of baccarat is to wager on the hand that is closest to 9. Baccarat is played with 8 decks of cards. Each player, including a dealer, gets 2 decks of cards.

### **Tie, Banker, or Player**

Baccarat has three options to wager: tie, banker, or player. Banker is another virtual player. After placing a bet, a player and a banker place the first card with the face-up, and the process is repeated once a player and a dealer receive the second card. Based on the value of the cards, the outcome of the round/croup is known after a player and a banker sum up their cards. If the sum is 9 (in the first two cards), it is called a ”natural win,” and if not, everyone gets the third card until 9 is reached. If the result is a tie, no one is successful, and that is called a standoff.

There is one thing that drastically differs from blackjack, and that is a house edge. The house edge represents a virtual percentage of the wagers that a casino takes after a certain time. Usually, it is 1.06% for a dealer, 1.24% for a player, and 14.4% for a tie.

## Card Values

![Card Values](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2019/04/cards4.png)

Below, we describe the value of baccarat cards. Summing up the points of each card, a player or a banker can define whether they win or lose.

- Ace = 1 point;
- 10s, Jacks, Queens, and Kings = 0 point;
- 1-9 cards = their face values.

How to calculate the value of your cards? If you get 8 and 7, that is 15. Now, you subtract 10, and you have left five, the value of 5 in your hand. Now you continue to chase the number 9. The winner is the one who gets to the value 9 first or gets “natural,” which is a hand that has cards that together combine the value 9.

Once your hand is over, you will get your winning paid. After this, to start a new round, you will have an opportunity to decide what to do with your next bet: rebet, clear it, or double it.

## **Best Online Baccarat Strategy**

Like any other card game, baccarat also has a range of strategies that might help you come closer to the win. We define three well-known systems used in online baccarat.

### Martingale strategy

According to this strategy, you should place an initial bet on the dealer. Like in every gambling adventure where you use this system, if a bet is lost, you double it until you pass. Once you pass, you need to go back to the initial wager and start applying it again. Keep in mind that you should use medium-sized bets, as the losing streak can easily rip your bank account off.

### Fibonacci’s system

This system is much less harmful to your balance. Basically, you place odds through a sequence of numbers of your selection. The next bet (in case you lose) is the sum of the previous two numbers. If you choose numbers 1,5,8,9 and you lose your first bet, the next bet will be 1+5=6, so it is 6. If you lose again, then you add 6 and 5, which is 11, and so on until you score. Once you score, you cover all the losses, and then you start again with a fresh sequence of numbers.

### D’Alembert’s strategy

The D’Alembert’s system is considered the safest one concerning your funds. Its principle is simple to comprehend. It basically increases your bet by the initial unit after each loss. You repeat the same action until you score.

## A Different Form of Paid Entertainment

Truly, we all need some entertainment. It’s not possible to constantly focus on work and obligations. Most entertainment options available in New Zealand at the moment cost money. A trip to the cinema, tickets for the opera, or even an evening at a cafe or bar with friends all come with a price. All of these require us to spend money, and similarly, playing online gambling games is no different.

So, what’s the difference one may ask? Essentially, the difference lies in the fact that you have the chance to win some NZD when playing games online or roulette or anything else. However, many times it is this excitement or anticipation that can get you into real trouble. It is important to know how to gamble responsibly, and if you can’t do that, you need to learn how.

## The Responsible Gambler Starts First with Research

Every time you try something for the first time, you should first ensure that a little research precedes to understand exactly what you are dealing with. There is really no reason to rush and proceed blindly. Would you play a game like roulette if you didn’t even know the rules? We can say that similar things are observed in any form of online gambling.

You can quickly check some websites that exist at the moment in New Zealand. There is no reason to sign up and start playing at this point. We are simply talking about research, so just take a look. Check the terms and conditions of each website. In case you find words whose meaning you are not familiar with, such as “betting requirements,” for example, conduct more specific research on those terms. Check social networks and chat websites related to gambling.

### Setting specific limits before you start playing games of chance is crucial

Setting a monetary limit before you begin is a good starting point for practising ethical and responsible gaming. You should already be aware of how much money you have left after paying bills and living expenses for yourself and your family. These are the only funds you should risk, and never attempt to spend money you cannot afford to lose.

### Setting a time limit on the gambling activities you engage in is equally important

Once you have decided on the monetary limit, the next step is to play responsibly.

Simultaneously, establish a specific time limit for each of your online gaming sessions. Unfortunately, it is easy to be carried away by the moment. This essentially means that the more you play, the more likely you are to lose money. Therefore, set a specific time limit from the beginning and adhere to it without second thoughts.

### Check your behaviour every time you play games of chance

It’s always good to start with good intentions. However, if your expectations ultimately fall through, as soon as you start playing online games of chance, you may find yourself in a mess. So, the next part of IcasinoReviews’ article about responsible gambling focuses on keeping yourself in check.

## Make Sure to be Especially Careful with the Offers

It is a fact that most players engaging in games of chance in New Zealand start betting online, claiming some welcome offers. This is, after all, the most popular type of offer. All casinos have them to attract new players to their online platforms. These offers may initially seem very generous, and players often claim them and win some money. At this point, they realize that they cannot withdraw their winnings until they fulfil the wagering requirement of the offer.

This is a classic example of when a New Zealand player may not read the terms and financial limitations set by the offer as part of responsible gambling. What has been observed is that enthusiasm and additional deposits eventually take over the mind. On your part, you must not let something like this happen.

## Remember that the Casino Usually Wins

In the realm of online gambling, whether we’re talking about free games on the internet or tabletop games, there is a mathematical advantage in favour of the casino expressed through RTP (Return to Player). The lowest advantage of this kind (known as the house edge) is typically 1.5%, and this applies to certain variations of blackjack. If the house edge is 1.5%, it means that the RTP is correspondingly 98.5%. You will never see an RTP of 100% or a higher percentage, meaning that you will lose in the long run with mathematical precision. Understanding this issue is of fundamental importance for responsible gambling.

The team at IcasinoReviews fully acknowledges that you can surpass estimates and win in the short term. However, over a longer period or in many games, you will lose.

### Don’t fall for the players’ betting fallacy

The “betting fallacy” is the mistaken belief that repeating conditions will replicate a previous win. However, this is never the case. All legal online casinos with licenses have RNG (Random Number Generators), software that determines the outcome of games, whether they are free online games, slots, card games, or anything else. The fact that we are dealing with something “random,” and understanding this factor, is absolutely crucial for learning responsible gambling.

The explanation of “random” in a dictionary is “an outcome that occurs without a specific aim, reason, or pattern.” Online betting platforms invest a significant amount of money in independent control and certification of their RNG software to ensure they produce random, fair results in every game of chance. IcasinoReviews, from its side, is able to confirm that repeated circumstances and resulting outcomes are nothing but random events.

## Utilizing Responsible Gambling Tools

If you wish to take your approach to responsible gambling to the next level, you might want to “customize” your own limits using the tools offered by the online casinos you use. Below are some of the most popular tools you can find.

### Responsible gambling betting limit tool

This tool allows you to set a daily, weekly, or monthly limit on money deposits. Note that it is not affected by transfers of money between different wallets or any withdrawals you may make. Any increases you attempt will not apply for 7 days, while requested decreases will take effect immediately.

### Financial loss limit tool

Our team at IcasinoReviews can inform you that chasing your financial losses is a bad idea. It’s an easy way to simply increase the losses you already have. However, with a financial loss limit tool, you can restrict the amount you are capable of losing or transferring within a specific time period.

### Responsible gaming break tool

New Zealand players who gamble and are experiencing a losing streak can use this tool to suspend their access to the casino for 1 to 30 days.

Other tools that can help you gamble responsibly include:

- Budget Calculation Tool – This helps you analyze your income and expenses to reach a possible betting budget.
- Reality Check – This tool considers any real money games you play. It operates every time you place a bet. It applies per session, and you receive a report after each session. It is informative, not restrictive.
- Responsible Gambling Self-Assessment – This tool asks you a series of questions about your activities in gambling. Based on your answers, it will indicate whether you are gambling responsibly or if you may be facing a problem.

One last tool you can use is self-exclusion, which we will delve into further below.

## What to do if You Feel You Can’t Stop Gambling

If you feel that you want to stop gambling but find it challenging to do so, it would be advisable to use a self-exclusion tool. This is the ultimate step that every New Zealand player should take when fearing that they cannot play games of chance responsibly.

Self-exclusion may also be referred to as self-banning. It is a step taken voluntarily. Once in effect, it completely excludes a player from areas of gambling websites or from any online betting site. All online gambling sites available in New Zealand are required to provide this option to their customers.

You can find various self-exclusion programs in New Zealand, which tend to operate in similar ways.

1. Select the online platform from which you wish to exclude yourself.
2. Sign an agreement or electronically submit a responsible statement to self-exclude for a period of not less than 6 months.

The advice that IcasinoReviews gives to players in New Zealand is to think twice before activating the self-exclusion command. Once activated, this command cannot be revoked until the requested exclusion period expires, and for at least 6 months.

If you believe you need help, here are several support organizations with which you can discuss how to play games of chance responsibly before making any hasty decisions that you might regret later – organizations such as GamCare and BeGambleAware.org. You may also find it helpful to read the guide “Gambling Addiction and Problem Gambling” on the helpguide.org website.

## **Bonus Terms and Conditions**

To use any bonus properly and be able to withdraw winnings, Kiwis must clearly understand and follow the bonus terms. Below, we’ve broken down the most important conditions you must consider.

- **Wagering Requirements**

Wagering requirements indicate how many times a gambler must wager the bonus funds. For example, if a $20 bonus has playthrough requirements of 30x, you’ll need to playthrough a total of $600 NZD (20×30) before cashing out.

Note: Not all games contribute to wagering requirements the same. The contribution of slots usually equals 100%, while table games and poker – up to 20%.

Game restrictions are another condition attached to most promos that you should pay attention to before claiming the bonus. These requirements limit Kiwis to wagering the bonus only on specific online casino games. Any gambler who does not adhere to game restrictions loses the $1deposit bonus and any associated winnings.

## How to Choose Real Money Casinos in New Zealand

As an authority on the [best online casinos in New Zealand](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/), I’ve refined the review criteria used in my evaluation to determine the characteristics of top casinos. These are listed and briefly explained next.

### Operating License and Regulation

It may surprise some readers that not all online casinos in New Zealand are licensed or regulated, which begs the question, “Why not?” After all, I wouldn’t give my money to an unlicensed service provider like an accountant or physician. Therefore, why would I give it to unlicensed casino sites?

Unlicensed NZ real money online casinos are accountable to no one and are best avoided. Authorised casinos in hands-off jurisdictions, like Panama or Costa Rica, are arguably not much safer. Therefore, it’s important to choose trustworthy offshore casinos authorised and regulated by reputable authorities. The Malta Gaming Authority and the UK Gambling Commission are two examples.

### Game Variety

Pokies tend to comprise the most significant component of games at casinos online, which makes them among the most diversified. Still, established [new online casinos](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/new-online-casinos-nz/) offer dramatically different software studios, impacting your options. A superior game portfolio includes a solid mix of more prominent studios and lesser-known/up-and-coming.

Unfortunately, more overall games don’t necessarily translate into a greater mix of roulette, blackjack, baccarat, casino/video poker games, craps, Slingo, etc. Therefore, I check for various tables and streaming game variants based on popularity or uniqueness.

### Regular Promotions and Bonuses at Online Real Money Casinos

It’s clear that great promos, bonuses, and other rewards can spice up everyday gameplay. Check for regular promos, including reloads and free spins (FS). Sometimes, these options can be part of a recurring weekly or monthly promotion.

Cashback promos are another type of promotion available at some of the better real money online casinos, offering bonus (casino play money) or actual money calculated as a percentage of losses.

Other online casino promos, like tournaments and competitions, involve competing head-to-head for a higher leaderboard ranking. The highest-ranking members win a share of a prize pool of non-monetary or cash winnings.

### Safety and Security

Like other internet merchants, online casinos NZ use Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption to protect information between its players. However, many other precautions can be taken to keep players secure. Examples include firewalls, antivirus & antispam software, website backups, monitoring tools, and password protection/2FA.

I feel very safe with RNG games, given each must be tested and certified fair by independent third-party-authorised and regulated labs. This ensures that no game has been tampered with to make one lose.

Likewise, licensed live play casino games stream from controlled studio environments where New Zealand members can play games in constant view of the host. Like RNG games, the tables are tested and certified.

A trusted casino also promotes responsible gambling by providing customisable tools that help players stay aware of their gameplay and keep it in check. These can include play and financial limits, short breaks of a few days/weeks, or self-exclusion by contacting customer support.

### Mobile Gaming

Developers optimise all modern online casino games for compatibility with smartphones and tablets. Even some older releases have been remastered in HTML5 for compatibility with Android/iOS mobile devices. This makes sense, considering some have become classics like the progressive Mega Moolah made in 2006.

Although all online and mobile casino websites operate on instant-play browsers, some operators have released a mobile app version. Mobile apps can have unique benefits, including increased reliability, speed, customisation, and user protection. However, I generally view online casino apps for mobiles and tablets as nice-to-have options rather than a must-have.

### Casino Withdrawals

Online casinos for real money may choose to apply daily, weekly, or monthly cash-out limits to transfer methods. Also, each casino determines the applicable handling fee, if any. While I’m happy to avoid these currency fees, a reasonable charge is not a dealbreaker.

Casino currency cash-out approval times typically vary from a few hours to 7 business days. I’d expect a [fast payout online casino NZ](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/fastest-payout-online-casino-nz/) to take up to three business days. The fastest payout online casino providers can take several hours. Alternatively, they may take days to complete the transfer, which I build into my expectation for receipt.

## Standard Terms To Watch Out for at Online Casinos

I appreciate that technical terms are enough reason to leave some members scratching their heads, particularly regarding promos and the banking section. Therefore, I put together a few bullet points to supply information that removes some mystery.

- Bonus money: Non-withdrawable casino money awarded as part of a promotion. Completing the playthrough requirement can transform it into withdrawable winnings, subject to limits, if any.
- Wagering requirement: The no. of playing rounds that casino money must be wagered before it becomes real, usually expressed as a multiple, like 35x. It’s also known as a playthrough requirement at many online casinos.
- Match Deposit Bonus: When the online casino matches a real deposit with a percentage in casino money, typically found in a welcome package. Regular members of casinos know it as a reload promo.
- Signup Bonus: An offer to a newly registered member who has yet to make a first deposit. The name can be misleading as some casinos require the signup to deposit first.
- Game contributions/weights: Refers to its contribution towards completing the wagering requirement. For example, a 100% weighting implies $1 wagered = $1 in playthrough.
- Minimum deposit requirement: The least amount a member can deposit, typically $10-20.
- KYC check/verification: A mandatory compliance process in which customer support requires proof of identity, age, and residence before processing a payout request.
- Casino cash-out period: The period an online casino takes to process a request, typically 24 hours to a few business days.
- Withdrawal limit: A cap on the earnings one can withdraw in a day, week, or month.
- Return to player (RTP): The theoretical percentage of money one will make back after playing a round. For example, a 96% RTP implies one wins $0.96 of $1 wagered. A [top paying online casino](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/best-payout-casinos/) tends to have a higher average RTP.
- Volatility/Variance: Typically refers to a particular slot’s risk and reward profile. Higher volatility has a higher potential of awarding juicier prizes. However, it also has a higher risk of burning through a bankroll faster.
