## **What is a 200% Deposit Bonus?**

A 200% deposit match is a reward that new players receive after registration in a NZ casino. Its size depends on the amount of the 1st deposit. The site sets a maximum cap that you are not allowed to exceed. For example, I often come across 200 percent [casino welcome offers](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/casino-bonus/) that allow you to get up to NZ$1000. If a player, e.g. deposits NZ$100, they receive NZ$200 on top. If a player replenishes their balance by a larger amount and the bonus amount exceeds NZ$1000, the 200% welcome bonus casino won’t be able to credit an amount greater than the fixed NZ$1000. Winnings can be withdrawn after meeting the wagering requirements.

These bonuses are loved by gambling enthusiasts in New Zealand because it provides a significant addition to the first top-up. Online casinos that offer a 200% casino bonus have an excellent reputation and boast a rich game collection. Players can use this reward on most of the game range and have a chance to win real cash without serious investment.

### **How to Claim a 200% Deposit Bonus?**

As soon as you come across a 200% match bonus casino NZ, register an account and proceed to claim welcome rewards. The procedure is almost identical in all the [best real money casinos](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/real-money-casinos/) that I’ve tested. Below I list detailed step-by-step instructions that will help you get a bonus match.

- Choose a reliable 200% welcome bonus casino and open its website
- Look for the registration button in the left or right corner of the screen
- Fill out the registration form and enter the necessary personal information. It includes the player’s first name and last name. Enter the date of birth and valid e-mail address. Provide your phone number and residential address
- After completing the registration, proceed to the Cashier section
- In the Deposits tab, find the most convenient payment system for you
- Decide on the amount you will pay and confirm the transaction
- Go to the Bonuses section and click on the activation button to claim the 200% casino bonus if it did not happen automatically. Enter promo code if required or follow additional instructions if necessary

### **Wagering Requirements**

Wager determines the amount that must be played through before withdrawing the winnings obtained as a result of gambling with bonus money. These rules apply to all types of bonuses, from [free spins bonus](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/free-spin-casino-bonus-nz/) to exclusive high-roller rewards. Wagering conditions protect New Zealand casinos from abuse of bonuses and ensure fair play on the part of players.It is essential to understand the established rules in the casino before claiming a bonus. I recommend that you always familiarize yourself with them in advance in Bonus Terms.

Let’s look at an example of how it works. The online casino offers a 200% welcome bonus with a 40x wager. This means that before withdrawing the winnings to your account, it’s necessary to wager 40x the total amount of your top-up and bonus funds. If you deposit NZ$50 and receive NZ$100 as bonus cash, you need to wager NZ$150\*40=NZ$6000 before withdrawing. Other bonus conditions may include the validity period, the maximum bet while wagering and limits on winnings or cashouts.

## **What is a 100% Deposit Bonus?**

The 100% bonus is a popular reward that casinos often couple with spins to entice players to join their gaming platform. In a nutshell, it is a gift equalling the amount of the top-up. Let’s say you deposit 100 NZD. The [sign up bonus casino](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/casino-bonus/) will give you 100 NZD (100%) in credits, so you will have a total of NZ$200 to play with.

Players should keep in mind that a 100% match bonus may be available as a welcome bonus or a separate reload promotion. The former is awarded to new customers and often comes in tandem with free spins — frequently for Book of Dead or other popular pokies. The second form is usually given to existing players or on a certain day of the week. Whichever the case, this type of casino reward is extremely popular among Kiwi players because it gives free money. Gamblers can use the credits to play their favourite slots and, overall, test a casino risk-free.

### **How to Claim an Online Casino 100% Deposit Bonus?**

Players need to register at a casino to get their hands on a 100% bonus offer. In short, here’s how the process looks at most top casinos:

- Visit the 100 match bonus casino and click ‘Register’.
- Follow the instructions in the pop-up form, asking for your email and some personal information. Make sure you indicate valid data.
- Verify your email.
- Next, make a qualifying deposit via one of the supported payment methods.
- If you see a box asking for a welcome bonus code, type it in if you have it. Most casinos will automatically give you a casino welcome bonus 100 without a code. It may include free spins.
- Play pokies according to the wagering rules to convert the credits and cash out your funds.

### **Bonus T&C**

Before playing with a 100% welcome slots bonus, I always consider the rollover, validity period, supported games, payment methods, and bet limits. Learn about each one below.

#### **Wagering Requirements**

A 100% welcome bonus online casino is usually tied to specific wagering rules. The rollover of match bonuses is how many times a player is required to wager the credit amount to turn it into withdrawable cash. 35x is the average on the market, but some sites require wagering 40x or more. I prefer 100 bonus promos with a rollover lower than 30x.

#### **Validity Period**

Each 100 bonus has an expiration period, typically up to 30 days. Players should convert deposit bonuses within the specified timeframe.

#### **Supported Games**

As with other bonuses, a 100% deposit match bonus will be playable with selected games. The slot category typically gives back 100 per cent, while table and live titles usually return 10-30%. Take my advice and play pokies.

#### **Payment Methods**

Not all payment methods are supported for deposit match bonuses. To help New Zealand players, I’ve only picked offers that allow the most popular options, like Skrill, Neteller, Paysafecard, VISA, and Mastercard.

#### **Bet and Top-Up Limits**

Players have to keep the limits in mind when it comes to a 100 bonus. Firstly, you need to know the min. deposit limit to activate the offer. And secondly, dig out the value of another key wagering requirement, the maximum bet allowed, as bigger wagers won’t be contributing to the 100 bonus progression.

#### **Max Cashout**

Every sign-up reward has a maximum winnings cap. The higher it is, the more real money you can withdraw. The average upper winnings cap for 100% deposit bonuses is NZ$2,000, but it can max out at NZ$10,000 or more at some gambling websites.

## **Choose the Best Casino with a 100% Deposit Bonus**

When I am faced with a 100 percent casino bonus, I always consider the following criteria to make sure I end up at the best casino:

1. **Licence and Security**

When you scroll through our recommended online casinos, you’ll learn they are all licenced and operate legally in New Zealand. To pick the best 100 no deposit bonus casino, make sure to double-check if a gambling site has a licence from a recognised regulator. Also, I always check for other security measures like SSL encryption and eCOGRA stamp of approval for the fairness of pokies.

2. **Bonus Value**

Match casino offers with higher amounts are just as sought-after as a [no deposit bonus NZ](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/no-deposit-casino-bonus-nz/). However, these bonuses usually come with more demanding wagering rules. Additional value comes from the presence of spins.

3. **T&C**

The best casino websites attach lower wagering rules to their welcome bonus. Look for promotions with a requirement of less than 30x and a max of 40x for the best possible experience. Also, keep in mind that wagering requirements for any attached spins are typically lower. On average, winnings from [free spins bonuses](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/free-spin-casino-bonus-nz/) at most casino websites have to be wagered 10-25 times.

4. **Number of Supported Casino Games**

The best online bonuses are compatible with more slot games. If you’re a player who is after the most favourable option, look for gambling sites that have many titles with 100% contributions to the wagering progression.

## **Alternatives to the 100% Deposit Bonus**

As sweet as a 100 bonus is, New Zealand players love the [200% match bonus casino NZ](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/200-bonus/) offers with spins on the side even more. 300% and 400% bonuses, plus slot spins, are even better. However, as you will essentially be receiving more for your money, these bonuses are rarer than a 100% promo and usually have a shorter validity date. Often, they require wagering 45x or more, compared to the 35x wagering requirements of a 100% offer. This makes them harder to convert. Here’s how the bonuses work:

- 200% Welcome Bonus — You will receive double your deposit and usually some spins. For example, if you top up NZ$50, you will get double that amount in credits.
- 300% Match — Players get triple the size of their deposit plus spins. For instance, if you top up 100 NZD, you will get NZ$300 in credits.

·400% Online Casino Reward — If you top up NZ$50, you will receive NZ$200, plus bonus spins.

## What are Free Spins Bonuses?

Free spins bonus offers are promos offered by the best online casinos. Such a bonus is usually given on specific slots. Its main perk is that it allows players to spin the reels with little or no real money investment. According to our experience, they are typically granted as a part of a welcome package for new users, as a promo for new slots, reload bonus or as a reward for special events and tournaments.

Online casino free spins may be awarded on a deposit or be granted as a no-deposit offer. The latter is the most sought-after promo since it doesn’t require any real money deposit and allows testing top-notch slot games. To get a [free spins no deposit](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/no-deposit-casino-bonus-nz/) promo, gamblers just need to establish an account at a casino. After that, a bonus is either granted automatically, or you’ll have to insert a promo code to claim it. The free spins deposit bonus is a different story, as players need to top up their account with an appropriate sum first before receiving it.

### Wagering Requirements

The term “wagering requirements” indicates how many times a player has to play through the bonus money before they can take out any winnings. It’s a typical requirement imposed on casino bonuses. An average wagering requirement is around 30-50x of the bonus sum or winnings from the FS. Let’s say you get [150 free spins](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/150-free-spins/) no deposit on Book of the Dead, with a rollover requirement of 30x. First, you’ll need to use your Book of Dead free spins. The rollover requirement applies to the winnings you get from the FS. Imagine you’ve won NZD$75. It means you’ll have to wager 75×30=NZD$2250 to turn your winnings into withdrawable cash.

As this rate may vary, our experts strongly recommend checking bonus T&Cs beforehand. In our casino reviews, we include up-to-date information about the wagering terms of top casinos, which you may check out. Some players might think that such casino conditions are unfair. On the contrary, the wagering requirement is designed to help gambling websites prevent abuse of bonuses and money laundering, as it ensures gamblers actually play at the casino and not only cash out the bonus.

## Types of Free Spins Bonuses

Free spins casino bonuses come in various forms, sometimes causing confusion among players. To help draw a line between all these kinds, we have prepared an overview of the main types found at online casinos:

1. **Free Spins No Deposit Bonus.** Gamblers are always looking for no deposit rewards as they are literally the [best casino bonus NZ](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/casino-bonus/) according to the feedback we receive. Our reviewed casinos with such promo provide the opportunity to spin the reels of their favourite slots without having to pay any money upfront. Upon registering, new players often receive these bonuses as a stand-alone offer. As the most beneficial promo that often leads to high wins, FS without a deposit are subject to higher wagering requirements than usual bonuses.
2. **Free Spins on Deposit**. These free spins offers are frequently given as recurring promos for loyal players or as part of welcome packages. The quantity of deposited money generally determines how many bonus FS are awarded: greater deposits typically translate into more free spins. Sometimes, a casino may set a predetermined number of FS for any deposit.
3. **Regular Free Spins Bonuses.** Online casinos periodically give out these promotions to incentivise the players’ activity. Regular FS are frequently connected to certain slot games or themes and may be offered on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis. Players can claim this bonus by meeting certain criteria, such as making a qualifying deposit during a promotional period or participating in casino tournaments.
4. **Free Spins Promotions.** Most online casinos use free spins New Zealand promos as a way to reward regular players and draw in new ones. These promos could be associated with a time-limited campaign or seasonal events like holidays or casino anniversaries.
5. **Deposit Bonus + Free Spins:** As a part of their welcome package or standard incentives, some casinos provide gamers with the opportunity to combine a deposit bonus with free spins. Players receive a certain number of FS to spend on specific slot games, in addition to a match bonus, dependent on their deposit amount.

The most common type of first deposit bonus on NZ online casinos is a match bonus. The way it works is – the casino will match your initial funding in a certain percentage, and you can use the awarded funds to play casino games according to bonus terms and wagering required.

In other words, if you get a 100% match, you’ll get a bonus amount equal to your deposit amount. So, if you put NZD100 into your casino balance, you’ll get another NZD100 as a bonus to play with. If you run upon a site with a 50% match offer, that means your initial NZD100 deposit will be turned into an NZD150.

Don’t worry, though, since 50% match offers are pretty rare, and you can even find deposit match offers higher than 100% on various NZ casinos.

## How Slot Games Work

In order to understand how online slots work, let’s explain how conventional slot machines work. The first game of this kind was known as Liberty Bell, invented in the United States by Charles Fey. It had 3 reels and once a user inserts a coin and pulls the lever, the reels will start spinning and stop at a specific time. The combination of the symbols measures the winning or losing strike. So, how do pokies machines? Now you know the answer.

An online slot works in the same way. Once you place a bet and press spin the reels will spin and stop at the specific location. Of course, the game is basically a long line of code and there are no moving parts. When and how the reels will stop is determined by the RNG. It stands for random number generator and it is present in all games. It has billion possible combinations and each one is randomly selected. This is the main reason why online slots are so fair to play. If you are wondering how to hack the pokies the answer is you can’t. The games are not present on the official casino site. They are located on the developer’s servers and you cannot reach the core of the game. As such, you cannot affect the RNG.

![online pockies](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-slot-machine.png)There are countless variations these days, but all the games work in the same way. This refers to the [3-reel](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/online-pokies-nz/3-reel-pokies/), [5-reel](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/online-pokies-nz/5-reel-pokies/), and any other type. Yes, the same format is used for [progressive jackpots](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/online-pokies-nz/progressive-jackpot/). Keep in mind that not all the games have the same RTP or return to the player. It is expressed in percentage and it is usually something like 98% or similar. It means that if a player invests $100, he will theoretically win back $98. However, this refers to long periods of time only and it isn’t something that can be changed.

## Guide For How to Play Pokies

Do you want to know how to play pokies online? Obviously, all New Zealanders know the basics. Pick a game, load it and place the bet, spin the reels and wait for the outcome. You may also believe that there are no other things to consider. Actually, there are a few and all of them will be covered and explained below.

### How many paylines should you activate?

If you want to know how to win on pokies you must know what paylines are. They are lines that go through all the reels and match symbols. If the right symbols are matched, a player wins. Now, a slot can have 3 reels and 3 payline sonly or it can have 5 reels and 1000 paylines. It depends on the game rather than on the casino. With 5-reel games, players have the ability to select how many paylines they want to activate. More paylines active, meaning you have more odds for winning. But, your bet will be higher as well, considering you must pay for each payline to become active.

Ideally, you will play with all paylines active. Yes, you do need a bigger bet but you also get better odds for winning. If you are a beginner with that slot, start with a few and then increase the activated paylines.

### What is the ideal bet?

![](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/data/uploads/2020/11/icasinoreviews-target.png)The ideal bet is the one that suits you the most. For most NZ gamblers it is the maximum bet you can get by pressing the max bet button. All paylines will be activated and you can expect the massive winning.

### What is the auto spin feature?

It means that the game will spin its reels automatically for a specified number of times. All winnings will be added to your account. A player has the ability to choose how many auto spins he needs. Generally speaking, many slots support 10, 20, 50 and 100 free spins. Once the number is reached, the game will be stopped and you can play using the spin button or activate auto spins again.

### What symbols mean?

Symbols are used to form proper and payable combinations. They are specific for the game or they can be generic such as J, K, A, 10 and Q. These are always low-value symbols. They do not form high-paying combinations. High-value symbols are always specific to the game and they form jackpots.

Many pokies do have a scatter symbol and a wild symbol. The scatter is responsible for forming bonus rounds. Basically, you can expect 20 [free spins](https://icasinoreviews.co.nz/free-spin-casino-bonus-nz/) or similar. A wild symbol is used to work winning jackpot combination and it can form others as well. It can replace any other symbol except the scatter.

## FAQ

What is RTP?

RTP stands for random number generator and it is an algorithm that will randomly display the combination of the symbols present on the reels. There are billion possible combinations.

What are the chances of winning on the pokies?

The chances are bets presented with a return to player or RTP. The higher the RTP, the higher are the odds for winning a jackpot or at least a winning combination.

Are all online pokies fair?

No, not all games on the web are fair to play. However, if you play at a trusted casino, you will play safe games. They are regularly tested and they are approved only if 100% fair for the gamblers.

Can pokies be hot or cold?

Yes, they can. A hot pokie is a game that hasn’t ‘’give’’ jackpot for a long period of time. As such, players will expect the jackpot any time soon. A cold slot is the one that did exactly the opposite. It has provided a lucky player with a jackpot and it won’t provide another one any time soon.

How do you pick a winning pokie machine?

The best thing to do is to pick a game with as close RTP to 100% as possible and to play slots that haven’t rewarded a player for at least 40 days. Also, activate all paylines and hope for the best.

## Pros and Cons of online casinos with internet banking

Every NZ online casinos with Internet banking offers a set of pros and cons to its players

### Pros of Internet banking casinos

Some of the pros of NZ online banking casinos are:

#### Widely Available in New Zealand

Direct banking online casinos are widely available in NZ offering a wide variety of games, live dealers and plenty of online payment options to New Zealanders

#### Security of Personal Details

Top internet banking casinos accepting NZ players use state-of-the-art security tools to encrypt your data for extra safety. Any unauthorised access is completely blocked by firewalls, SSL encryption, 2FA, and IDS thereby minimising the risk of data breach.

#### High Transaction Limits

NZ casinos accepting internet banking payments offer high transaction limits. Meaning you can deposit or withdraw larger amounts when playing your game, accommodating the wide range of bets depending on your playing style.

### Cons of Internet banking casinos

Although there are many pros of NZ online casinos with internet banking however there are also some cons.

#### Withdrawal Processing Time

The withdrawal speed may differ based on the payment method used and the casino policy. Some NZ casinos accepting internet banking payments take several days to process the winnings. This affects your game and takes the charm away from the whole gaming experience.

#### 3rd-Party Tools Usage

Some NZ online casinos with Internet banking use 3rd party tools to process your payments. This could compromise the reliability of the casino and the security of your details.

## Popular Banking Options Offered By Internet Banking Casinos

With Internet banking being established in New Zealand you will find many top internet banking casinos accepting NZ players that offer widely used payment.

Below is a list of the top online payment methods used by NZ online banking casinos –

- **Master/Visa Card**– Master cards or Visa cards are trustworthy and efficient traditional payment methods that are widely accepted by online casinos with internet banking. The majority of adults in New Zealand have atleast one of these cards used for paying their bills that can be further used in a casino.
- **Skrill**– Skrill is another common payment method offered by almost all online casinos. This payment method charges very little transaction fees and allows quick withdrawals which is a crucial factor in casino gaming.
- **Neteller**– Neteller is a popular internet banking method with a convenient e-wallet allowing you to instantly transfer funds for placing bets. This is one of the earliest e-wallets introduced in the NZ casino world and you will find it in almost all casinos accepting internet banking payments in New Zealand.
- **Neo Surf**– Neo Surf is a prepaid payment card, that you need to recharge before you can use it. This provides all the benefits of the prepaid card and is best for those who prefer anonymity over their financial records.
- **PayPal**– PayPal stands at the forefront of online secure payments. Signing up with PayPal only takes 5 minutes and allows quick and easy transactions and you will find it in almost all NZ online casinos with Internet banking.
- **POLi**– Poli is one of the most sought-after payment methods in New Zealand. This method allows you to directly transfer funds to the casino without the use of a credit or debit card.
- **Apple Pay**– Apple Pay is noted for its security and speed. All you need to do is use your face ID or touch id and instantly transfer funds to your internet banking casinos without sharing the bank details.
- **EcoPayz**– EcoPayz is a very popular payment method in New Zealand that allows you to fund your account with ease. This payment method uses 2FA, secure login and fraud detection making it one of the safest options New Zealanders rely on.
- **BitCoin**– BitCoin is one of the most trusted cryptos that is gaining popularity in the casino world. You will find many NZ online banking casinos introducing BitCoins as a payment method allowing complete anonymity with fast deposits and withdrawals.

What popular payment methods are accepted by NZ online banking casinos?

NZ online casinos accept credit cards, debit cards, e-wallets like POLi, Neteller, Neo Surf, and even cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum. You can also pay using Skrill, Apple Pay, EcoPayz and PayPal

Why should I only play at Internet banking casinos that accept NZ$?

Casinos that accept NZ$ will prevent the hassle of conversion and extra charges that are levied by payment methods for changing the currency. There are many casinos accepting internet banking payments with NZ$ offering hundreds of games and payment options.

Are casino bonuses provided by every online casino deposit with bank account?

Most of the time NZ online casinos with internet banking have special offers assigned with the payment methods, but these are not available when using E-wallets. If you want to secure a bonus then a credit or debit card is the safest option.

Do I have to pay taxes on my winnings in NZ online banking casinos?

You are not obligated to pay taxes on your winnings, however, if you are a professional gambler, and use that money to invest or save then you are liable to pay taxes.

How do I know which online casino internet banking NZ is safe?

A safe online casino internet banking NZ will have logos and emblems of the appropriate governing bodies along with a license from major territories ensuring the legitimacy of the casino. Other than these you can always see the SSL certificate on the casino website giving you a clear indication of its safe usage.
